translation: <ins>Jia Jian Su Zi Tao Ren Tang (加減蘇子桃仁湯)</ins> Treats internal accumulation of stagnant blood, heat of the heart channel, and cases where the large intestine is not dry. Perilla seed (蘇子, three qian), sappan wood powder (蘇木末, one qian), safflower (紅花, one qian), peach kernel (桃仁, stir-fried), ophiopogon (麥冬), tangerine peel (橘紅, each three qian), red peony (赤芍), bamboo shavings (竹茹), Chinese angelica (當歸, washed in wine, each two qian). Boil in three cups of water down to one cup; for the dregs, two cups down to eight-tenths, take warm. <ins>Dao Qi Tong Yu Ding (導氣通瘀錠)</ins> A special formula specifically for treating deafness.
